name: Program Peningkatan Jalan Daerah
description: Peningkatan jalan kabupaten/kota. Lama dibangun; manfaat terbesar di daerah dengan jalan paling buruk.

provenance.note: Game policy option. Not a description of a real government programme; magnitudes are uncalibrated design values.

effects.label: Infrastruktur naik bertahap (~10 poin rata-rata); memperbaiki logistik, harga pangan, ketahanan banjir, dan pemulihan

game_design_notes: Causal: infrastructure -> logistics -> food realization & trade -> price -> welfare; infrastructure -> flood resilience & recovery speed.
